card.name: Word endings: medica and injectable
card.fires_on: The final piece of a word that is completed here: "ica" ending Spanish "medica" in label phrases, and "able" ending "injectable" before a drug or form name.

modes.label: Spanish medica
modes.description: Ending of "medica" in Spanish label phrases such as prescription-only sale or medical indication.
modes.example: ​Medicamento Homeopatico. Venta bajo prescripcion med<<ica>>. Mantengase fuera del alcance

modes.label: Injectable
modes.description: Ending of "injectable" before a drug, suspension or emulsion name.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Methylprednisolone acetate inject<<able>> suspension is contraindicated in patients
